title.narrative: Empowerment of women and girls in education: from rights to opportunities

description.narrative: The project "Empowerment of women and girls in education: from rights to opportunities" aims to promote the creation of an educational environment free from gender-based discrimination, fostering the development and self- realization of every girl and woman, regardless of gender. Running from May 1st to December 31st, 2024 it seeks to provide a platform for discussing the challenges faced by women in the field of education and seeking solutions to address them Expected results include improved knowledge and skills through conducting a two conferences and one workshop, the creation of a support network of educational professionals willing to collaborate and support each other in gender equality matters. Project activities include two conferences addressing key practices and stereotypes in education and workshop on women's potential in education leadership, issuance of booklets on women's statistics in education, and the development of recommendations.
